_about: Aesthetic policy for lib/visual.mjs, not architecture: every table here may be replaced. moodThreshold: how far (in axis units) a song's mean axes must lean along an overlay's direction before it has that mood; an overlay vector is ~.3-.5 long. selection: how a song with no `visual` header picks its world, deliberately fuzzy: each world's row is a base score plus weights over the song's features (every axis by name as its mean lean in -1..1, and tempo, sections, repetition, complexity, melody, pad from featuresOf), the scores go through a softmax at `temperature` (higher: more even odds), and the song's seed samples from the odds, so a world that fits moderately can still win and the same song always gets the same world. temperature: key mode -> a palette word. palette: visual property -> the axis whose song-wide mean it reads. voices: drum voice -> its role in any world. kinds: layer kind -> the slots it may take, in order; grain is unbounded and every list ends there. worlds: slot capacities per world, and traits for the director (web/visual/director.mjs): cumulative (the world keeps history, so it is never restarted mid-song), motion (high ones are dimmed past two at full strength), minTile (the smallest height fraction it reads at), minAspect (loom keeps its flywheel), overlay (the blend it overlays with: screen on a dark ground, multiply on a light one, byLuminance for ink's own rule; absent: never an overlay), overlayMax (an opacity cap as an overlay), finalFrame (its last frame is a picture, so a release may end on it). compositions: the director's presets, count the worlds each takes when the song lists none (filled from the selection's odds).

single.about: one world full-frame: the stage as it always was

overlay.about: the primary full; the second world a transparent overlay whose opacity follows the section's energy; the third a circle portal from the first developing section

mosaic-climax.about: the primary full throughout; develop adds the second world over it; the climax adds the rest as insets of one seeded mosaic the primary bleeds through; the release collapses back, or to a listed world that makes a final frame
